procedures.name: ShowPriceListLines
procedures.doc: Displays price list lines for this general ledger account filtered by price type and amount type.

procedures.name: SetupNewGLAcc
procedures.doc: Initializes a new general ledger account with default values based on an existing account. Copies income/balance classification and other relevant setup from the reference account.

procedures.name: CheckGLAcc
procedures.doc: Validates that the general ledger account is ready for posting transactions. Checks that account type is Posting and account is not blocked.

procedures.name: ValidateAccountSubCategory
procedures.doc: Validates and sets the account subcategory based on text input from user interface. Matches input text against available subcategory descriptions for the account category.

procedures.name: LookupAccountSubCategory
procedures.doc: Opens a lookup page for selecting account subcategory based on the account's income/balance type and category. Updates the account category and subcategory based on user selection.

procedures.name: GetCurrencyCode
procedures.doc: Returns the additional reporting currency code from General Ledger Setup. Used for additional currency amount formatting in flowfields.

procedures.name: ValidateShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Validates and updates the shortcut dimension code for the specified dimension field. Saves the dimension value as a default dimension for this account.

procedures.name: TranslationMethodConflict
procedures.doc: Checks for consolidation translation method conflicts with other accounts using same consolidation accounts. Prevents inconsistent translation methods for accounts that consolidate to the same target account.

procedures.name: CheckGenProdPostingGroup
procedures.doc: Validates that the general product posting group is specified for the account. Logs an error message if the posting group is missing for posting-type accounts.

procedures.name: IsTotaling
procedures.doc: Determines whether the account type supports totaling functionality. Returns true for Total and End-Total account types used in account hierarchies.

procedures.name: OnAfterCheckGLAcc
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after validating that a general ledger account is ready for posting. Allows extensions to add custom validation logic for account posting readiness.

procedures.name: OnAfterSetupNewGLAcc
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting up a new general ledger account with default values. Allows extensions to add custom initialization logic for new accounts.

procedures.name: OnAfterValidateShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after validating and updating shortcut dimension codes. Allows extensions to perform additional processing after dimension validation.

procedures.name: OnBeforeValidateShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating shortcut dimension codes. Allows extensions to modify validation logic or skip default validation.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckGenProdPostingGroup
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before checking general product posting group requirements. Allows extensions to override or supplement posting group validation logic.

procedures.name: OnBeforeOnDelete
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before deleting a general ledger account. Allows extensions to perform custom validation or cleanup before account deletion.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckSalesOrdersPrepmtToDeduct
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before checking sales orders with prepayments to deduct. Allows extensions to override or supplement prepayment validation logic for sales orders.
